_comment: Known PyTorch c10d NCCL test failures in this ROCm/RCCL CI suite. Tests listed here are excluded from the pass/fail verdict so that a new failure is visible against them. Most entries are not regressions — some are ROCm runtime behaviour, some are test assumptions that do not hold on ROCm. A minority are active defects with an open ticket, suppressed only to keep the suite's signal readable; those say so explicitly in their category description. Exclusion from the verdict is never a statement that a test is expected to fail forever. Remove each entry once its underlying cause is resolved.

categories.missing_duration_ms: RCCL flight recorder trace omits duration_ms field
categories.missing_optype_broadcast: RCCL completion hooks don't report OpType.BROADCAST
categories.watchdog_timeout: RCCL watchdog timing differs from upstream NCCL
categories.trace_timeout: Flight recorder trace tests exceed pytest-timeout (600s)
categories.trace_entry_mismatch: Trace entry structure differs from upstream NCCL
categories.missing_dump_pipe: RCCL does not create flight recorder dump pipe
categories.pg_timeout_semantics: extend_pg_timeout adds to existing vs sets absolute value
categories.extra_context_heuristic: Test infers an extra HIP context from >70% device memory growth across a collective; on ROCm the growth is a ROCr runtime allocation, not a second context and not RCCL memory. Magnitude is build- and arch-dependent, and the ratio also varies with node co-tenancy (AICOMRCCL-2469)
categories.split_group_parent_guard: Upstream PyTorch #195758 (e8430bed0, 2026-09-03) made split_group reject a parent process group that was bound to a device_id but has not yet run a collective. The test splits recursively without issuing one. Surfaced when this suite moved off a frozen wheel onto the current ROCm nightly; the guard's sibling split_group tests pass on ROCm, so the guard itself is satisfiable here and this is not simply an unsupported upstream API. Which ROCm-side condition leaves the parent group unprimed in this test specifically is not yet identified (AICOMRCCL-3107)
categories.nccl_backend_4gpu_hang: ACTIVE DEFECT, not a feature gap: the 4-GPU DDP module test hangs with both ranks unresponsive and is killed at the 300s timeout. Suppressed only to keep the suite's signal readable while the hang is investigated — remove this entry as soon as AICOMRCCL-2468 is fixed
